name: Rune of Nesting
summary: At Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the Rune of Nesting helps prepare a rite to wake the Druids of the Talon. They sleep in the Emerald Dream, and four sacred relics guide their safe return.

sections.title: A Sacred Focus for Awakening
sections.body:
Deep in the winding chambers of Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the Rune of Nesting lies in the Chest of Nesting. Night elf druids sleep in underground barrow dens and commune with nature through the Emerald Dream.

To return safely, the Druids of the Talon need a careful awakening ritual guided by sacred relics. The Rune of Nesting is one of four, alongside the Raven Claw Talisman, the Black Feather Quill, and the Sapphire of Sky. Together, the relics call the sleeping druids back to the waking world.

sections.title: Crisis in Ban'ethil
sections.body: Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and its sleeping defenders are in peril. Without the relics, the druids may remain trapped in the Emerald Dream while invaders desecrate their sanctuary. Recovering the Rune of Nesting and its companion relics lets Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar prepare the rite that can wake them safely.

faq.q: What is the Rune of Nesting used for?
aliases: what does rune of nesting do
faq.answer: Athridas Bearmantle needs the Rune of Nesting to prepare the ritual that safely wakes the Druids of the Talon from their deep sleep in the Emerald Dream. It is one of the four Relics of Wakening used in the rite.

faq.q: Where is the Rune of Nesting found?
faq.answer: The Rune of Nesting lies in the Chest of Nesting, in the underground tunnels of Ban'ethil Barrow Den, west of Dolanaar on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why can't the sleeping druids simply wake up on their own?
aliases: why do druids need waking ritual
faq.answer: The druids enter a delicate trance when they sleep in the Emerald Dream. Without sacred relics and an awakening ritual, they may be unable to return, leaving their minds adrift and their bodies in danger.

faq.q: What other relics are needed alongside the Rune of Nesting?
faq.answer: The rite calls for four Relics of Wakening: the Rune of Nesting, the Raven Claw Talisman, the Black Feather Quill, and the Sapphire of Sky.

angles.text: As a druid, you know the Rune of Nesting belongs to the sacred rites of the Cenarion Circle. It speaks to the danger sleeping brethren face when their sanctuaries are breached.
As a night elf, you see the loss of wakening relics and the desecration of barrow dens as signs of growing corruption among Teldrassil's wildlife and furbolgs.
